correctness.rationale: For set partitions of [n], n>=2, and any simple frequency graph H with m edges, expand each Walsh character as product_{e in H}(1-2 I_e) to obtain W(H)=sum_{F subset H}(-2)^|F| B_{c(F)}. Two distinct simple edges always reduce the n component count by two, giving W=B_n-2m B_{n-1}+4 binom(m,2)B_{n-2} modulo 8. Stirling residue classes modulo 8 obey the eight-state recurrence M; the check M^24 e0-e0=4(e0+e4) and its six-step mod-2 even-weight orbit proves Bell B_{n+24}=B_n mod8 for ALL n. The 24 initial Bell values determine each parity-dependent valuation (classes 0,1,3,4,6,7,9,10 odd; 5,8,11 valuations 1 or 2; class 2 even m valuation 1, odd m unclassified). Rank/invertibility follow from nonzero diagonal Walsh entries, and the exceptional n=2 rank-one case is explicit. Independent exhaustive integer Walsh transforms for n=2..6 and modular-state period checks matched the congruence and zero counts. n≡2 mod12 odd-m nonvanishing is NOT proved.
